newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia makes Treasury head deputy finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Russia makes Treasury head deputy finance minister.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin appointed Treasury chief Alexander Smirnov Deputy Finance Minister, Interfax news agency quoted Finance Ministry sources as saying on Friday.
Smirnov remains in charge of the Treasury, which is taking on an increased role as the government restructures public finances.
President Boris Yeltsin in his address to parliament on Thursday said all budget funds would in future be channelled solely through the Treasury, not commercial banks.
Last year Yeltsin fired Smirnov for mismanaging budget funds intended for pensions and wages. But later Smirnov returned to his position.
